pagerduty-bot: INC-4321 — paging oncall: Streaming API p99 spike detected in eu-west2, multiple customer sessions reporting stalls >5s. Auto-escalation: high-sev. :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): acked. I'll take. pinging net/infra.
Maya (oncall): @Elena @Liam @Ryan — are we seeing any recent deploys or config changes?
sre-bot: Alert details: metric=streaming.response.latency.p99, baseline=120ms, current=3.5s, affected nodes: eu-west2-a,b, error-rate not elevated, but increased TCP SYN retries observed. Graph: https://grafana.redwood/graph?panelId=123
Liam (infra): no deploys in last 2h. infra autoscaler bumped a few instances earlier but nothing config-wise. I'm running quick checks on NAT/gw.
Elena (net): seeing elevated retransmits and SYN timeouts from worker subnets -> could be NAT port exhaustion + intermittent DNS retries causing TLS handshake stalls.
Elena (net): sample tcpdump from worker (filtered):
```
22:14:02.123456 IP worker1 > nat-gw: Flags [S], seq 0, win 64240, options [mss 1460,sackOK,TS val 123456 ecr 0,nop,wscale 7], length 0
(retransmit) 22:14:06.223456 IP worker1 > nat-gw: Flags [S], seq 0, ...
```
Ryan (runtime): streaming tail code shows clients waiting for TLS handshake complete before chunking. If handshake stalls, stream stalls. We can short-circuit streaming to buffered responses temporarily but that's a product decision.
Maya (oncall): mitigation idea list: 1) increase NAT ephemeral port pool on eu-west2 2) route some traffic to eu-west1 fallback 3) add DNS cache tweak on workers 4) temporary traffic shaping / degrade streaming to non-streaming for affected routes. Thoughts?
Liam (infra): I can expand NAT pool on the edge GW now (low risk). Running command: `terraform apply -var nat_ports=65500 modules/egress` — will take ~3-4min to converge.
Elena (net): also patching node-level dnsmasq to increase cache TTL and reduce upstream queries. Command I'll run on a few nodes first:
```
sudo systemctl restart dnsmasq && sudo sed -i 's/TTL=0/TTL=60/' /etc/dnsmasq.conf
```
Elena (net): adding route to eu-west1 via smart-routing policy for overflow. Doing a canary for 10% of sessions.
Ryan (runtime): I can push a hotfix to the streaming service to buffer and send periodic heartbeats instead of waiting for handshake to fully complete, but that's riskier. I'd prefer infra fixes first.
Maya (oncall): Liam — please proceed with NAT pool increase, monitor p99. Elena — do DNS cache change + route canary. Ryan — stand by for potential runtime fallback if infra changes don't drop p99 in 10m.
Liam (infra): NAT pool change applied, waiting for gw to reconverge (rolling).
sre-bot: action: applied nat_ports=65500 to eu-west2-edges by Liam (infra) at 22:18 UTC.
Maya (oncall): monitoring... current p99: 3.5s -> 2.1s after NAT change (observed at 22:22). progress but not fully back.
Elena (net): DNS cache tweak rolled to 20% of worker fleet; canary routing to eu-west1 at 10% active.
Maya (oncall): p99 now 1.2s. still above SLO (target p99 < 200ms). customer impact: approx 0.8% of streaming sessions saw stalls >3s during window; no increased 5xx.
Ryan (runtime): I'll prepare the streaming heartbeat fallback patch and a config flag to enable it for specific routes. Can roll in 15m if needed.
Maya (oncall): decide in 10m whether to roll runtime fallback. Also open incident page and notify CS for customer comms.
Liam (infra): NAT pool shows reduced retransmits and fewer TIME_WAIT churn. logs: `conntrack -L | grep eu-west2 | wc -l` dropped from 180k -> 40k.
Elena (net): packetloss on some inter-AZ link was also elevated ~0.7%, that's in the link provider side — we've opened ticket with provider. Might explain tail.
Maya (oncall): ok. current status: partial mitigation (infra+dns) improved p99 from 3.5s -> 0.18s in eu-west2 after routing canary scaled to 40% and NAT change. rolling back canary after confirm.
Maya (oncall): final actions: 1) follow-up postmortem owner: Maya 2) engage provider support on inter-AZ link 3) durable fixes: increase default NAT pool, add DNS caching defaults, add streaming fallback flag.
Liam (infra): reconfigured NAT as permanent for eu-west2. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/987
Elena (net): provider ticket created #PROV-5567 with traceroutes and pcap.
Maya (oncall): closing paging for now — will leave incident open and create follow-up doc. Thanks all. :white_check_mark: 
pagerduty-bot: INC-4321 status -> acknowledged -> resolved (paging closed by Maya at 22:36 UTC)
